name: FormPDF
title: PDF editing that stays on your computer
summary: FormPDF is a free, open-source PDF editor that runs on your computer, with in-place text editing, redaction, OCR, signing, forms and an agent dock.
lede: FormPDF is a PDF editor in the Form family that runs on your computer. It is built so that Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can do PDF work in the open window while you watch, with every agent turn undoable at once.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux (browser or Tauri desktop)
checks: Edits the text and pictures a PDF already has, in place and in its own font where possible.
Finds and redacts so that the content under each box is removed and the rest stays text.
Makes scanned pages searchable with OCR that runs on this computer.
Fills forms, signs with a digital ID, and checks every signature in plain sentences.

facts.dd: PDF by picker, drop or path; also creates PDFs from pictures and Word, PowerPoint or Excel files through your LibreOffice
Python 3.12 FastAPI engine on 127.0.0.1:8198, app on http://localhost:5198
Preferences lists every network connection (none leave this computer)

chapters.title: Edit the text a PDF already has
chapters.text: Page text and pictures stay editable, with fonts, styles, alignment and lists, crop, rotate, flip and replace. Headers, footers, Bates numbers, page numbers and watermarks are added in the same window.

chapters.title: Redact, password and clean
chapters.text: Find and redact removes the content under each box while the rest stays text, and marks from other apps are applied too. Passwords, permissions, metadata and hidden information are handled in the same panel.

chapters.title: An agent dock with undo for every turn
chapters.text: Ctrl+J (Cmd+J on a Mac) opens a dock with real terminals, your own Claude Code and a Chat tab. Changes land live in the window, and Edit > Undo agent turn takes back the whole turn.

features.title: Home
features.text: Open, create, merge and scan from one start screen.
bullets: Open a PDF by picker, drop or path, with recent PDFs and forget
Create a PDF from pictures and Word, PowerPoint or Excel files
Merge PDFs, and scan from network and connected scanners
Batch: one action on many PDFs, results in a new folder
Pick up where you left off, including unsaved changes after a crash

features.title: View
features.text: Single, continuous, two-page and cover layouts.
bullets: Reading mode and read aloud
Find and compare two PDFs
Document properties
Mod+K finds any command or tool in your own words

features.title: Comment
features.text: Mark up a PDF and track replies.
bullets: Highlight, underline, strike through, notes, text boxes, ink, shapes, lines and arrows
Replies and status, and stamps
Measure distance, perimeter and area
Export and import comments as XFDF

features.title: Fill forms and sign
features.text: Fill form fields with the standard AcroForm calculations, formats and range checks running as you type.
bullets: Draw or type a signature
Sign with a digital ID (certify, lock fields, timestamp)
Check every signature in plain sentences
Request signatures in order
Prepare forms with text, check box, radio, dropdown, list box, date and signature fields

features.title: Edit
features.text: Edit the text a PDF already has in place, in its own font where possible.
bullets: Pictures already on the page moved, cropped and replaced
Arrange and align
Headers and footers with Bates numbers
Crop, page numbers, watermark, links and attached files

features.title: Organize
bullets: Rotate, delete, reorder and insert pages
Split and merge

features.title: Extract
features.text: Pull content out of a PDF.
bullets: Text as .txt or .md
Pictures
Tables as CSV or .xlsx

features.title: Protect
bullets: Passwords and permissions, and remove a password
Find and redact: the content under each box is removed, the rest stays text
Marks from other apps applied too
Metadata and remove hidden information

features.title: Convert
features.text: Move between PDF and other formats.
bullets: OCR that runs on this computer
Export to PowerPoint (one slide per page, words as real text boxes), Word, Excel, HTML and RTF
Compress, and pages to pictures

features.title: Accessibility
features.text: Check against 32 PDF/UA and WCAG rules with a fix for each repairable one and an HTML report.
bullets: Tag the PDF from its layout
Edit the reading order on the page
Alternate text figure by figure

features.title: Print
bullets: Pages per sheet, booklets and posters with a live sheet preview
Real grayscale
PDF/A-2b, 2u and 3b check and convert
PDF/X-4 with your printer's profile
Preflight with fixups and a report

features.title: Automation
bullets: Five built-in action lists, or record your own
Run on the open PDF or in Batch
Plug-ins add actions and tool sections, off until you allow them

features.title: Assistant
features.text: Ask or summarise with page links and checked quotations; off until you choose.
bullets: Draft a presentation from several files
Generate a picture onto the page
Runs through your agent, Anthropic or OpenAI with your key, or a model on your computer

features.title: Agents
features.text: An MCP server over HTTP at /mcp or stdio.
bullets: Tools: get_context, open_pdf, pdf (83 actions and any from plug-ins), render_pages, extract, save, undo, answer_question
Agent dock with terminals, Claude Code and a Chat tab
Edit > Undo agent turn takes back the whole turn

parity.summary: Of the 72 Acrobat capabilities traced, FormPDF is full on 66, partial on 5 and has nothing for 1. What is left is narrow: designed AI decks, service-sent signing requests, form JavaScript beyond Acrobat's standard functions, CMYK and flattening for print, a screen reader pass, and hosted share links.

requirements: Rust and the Tauri 2 system packages for the desktop build
docs.agents: ./formpdf agents install writes .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json; Claude Code alone can use: claude mcp add --transport http formpdf http://127.0.0.1:8198/mcp

topics.title: Install and run
topics.text: The README gives the commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formpdf.bat), the one-click installers, and ./formpdf doctor to check Python and Node.

topics.title: Desktop
topics.text: ./build_app builds the app start to finish; the README lists the Debian and Ubuntu packages Tauri needs and the .app/.dmg, .msi/.exe, .deb/.AppImage outputs.

topics.title: Agents
topics.text: The README describes the agent dock (Ctrl+J), the MCP tools, ./formpdf cli, and a sample prompt for Bates numbers and redaction.

topics.title: Data
topics.text: Everything stays in ~/Formpdf: Pdf, Media and Exports folders, settings.json, with FORMPDF_DATA_DIR and FORMPDF_PORT to override.

topics.title: Manual
topics.text: docs/MANUAL.md is the manual, and docs/PARITY.md has every traced capability row.

topics.title: Known gaps
topics.text: The README lists known gaps, including no CMYK conversion, OCR adding about 150 MB to an install, and limits on editing text inside Type 3 fonts.

items: The About box and the installers name NodeAgentc, Inc. and the licence
Added a code of conduct, contributing guide and security policy
The window's scripts keep their types on Windows
A release build fails when text recognition (OCR) is missing
The backend freeze step hands PyInstaller Windows paths on Windows
The macOS requirements are pinned to the Linux and Windows versions

shots_wanted.what: A PDF open with a text paragraph being edited in place
shots_wanted.how: Run ./formpdf, open http://localhost:5198, open any text PDF from Home, then use the Edit tools to click a paragraph.

shots_wanted.what: The find and redact panel with matches previewed as black boxes
shots_wanted.how: Open a text PDF, go to Protect, choose find and redact, search for a word that appears several times and tick the matches.

shots_wanted.what: The agent dock open at the bottom of the window
shots_wanted.how: With a PDF open press Ctrl+J (Cmd+J on a Mac) and show the Chat tab.

shots_wanted.what: The Home screen with recent PDFs
shots_wanted.how: Open two or three PDFs, then return to Home.
